notes:
- Customer: Brightmoor builds orchestration for omnichannel contact centers. Primary ask: real-time agent assist with streaming suggestions and safe tool-calling into their ticketing/workflow system.
- Latency expectations: interactive feel for agents, target 95p < 80ms for streaming token delivery; absolute hard SLO 150ms end-to-end for suggestion latency.
- Throughput spikes are expected during promo events: baseline ~40 reqs/s, expected spikes to 300-400 reqs/s for short windows. They care about graceful degradation (fallback to cheaper model + partial suggestions rather than timeouts).
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, per-tenant audit logs, strict data residency (US-east), ability to integrate with customer KMS.
- Integration notes: want tool-calling for create/update ticket actions; need deterministic guardrails (templated actions + confirmation step). Also request for response hallucination controls and response provenance metadata exposed in UI.
- Quote from Product Lead: "We need suggestions that don't slow our agents down — streaming is a must. If the model stalls, we'd rather get a short recommended snippet than nothing."
- POC scope: 2-week technical POC inside customer VPC (Dedicated or Private trial), 10 live agents, automated spike test harness, regression tests with our prompt set.
- Pricing sensitivity: mid — willing to pay for reserved throughput but want clear unit economics from Optimize recommendations.
- Decision factors: latency & availability during spikes, security sign-off, demo to ops and procurement.
- Internal: AE pushing for Dedicated proposal + 6-month reserved capacity option; SE to validate autoscaling/burst behaviour and KV caching impact on token cost.
